quest.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quest.description: Slimes have suddenly shown up at Dawn Winery, and it seems Tunner has become caught up in the commotion...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: I just wanted to tend to the grape vines, and then... this happened.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: *sigh* Please don't say a word about this to my son. He's one of the Knights of Favonius, so I'm sure he has enough to worry about as it is.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: There's no need to bother him over a silly old man getting himself into a bit of a pickle.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Recently, though, we do seem to be having a bit of a slime problem around the winery area. I worry constantly that they'll demolish my grape vines. It's keeping me up at night.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: I don't know if you have the time to spare for an old man like me... but if so, could you chase off the slimes in the area for me, to stop them from getting at my grapes?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Bless you, child! I will rest better for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: *sigh* I would happily do it myself, but at my age my strength is not what it used to be... For a youngster like you, this should be no problem. Come on, make an old man's day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, what have we here? It looks like dust, but... with elemental traces on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the last of them. But Paimon wonders what they were doing hanging around here?

talks.objective: Use Anemo to blow out the dust
